A panel of the dome is pulled back and a telescope is positioned in the opening.

Photo of the Burlington Pioneer Zephyr "Dawn to Dusk Club" comprised of those who rode the Pioneer Zephyr on its intial 1934 record breaking trip from Denver to Chicago.  The group was gathered at Chicago's Union Station to mark the first trip of the Denver Zephyr for regular service between these two cities. 

This image was digitally restored and its watermark removed by Centpacrr at en.Wikipedia.
